summary: Short kerb on a bush-lined road stub off Carmody Road; homes 31 m away.
reasons: Bush both sides, homes 31 m off

best_section.where: East side of the Fifth Avenue stub, just south of the Carmody Road junction

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on both sides; nearest homes 31 m and further, beyond the trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Reachable from Carmody Road via a narrow sealed stub; width beside the lane looks tight and the section is only 8 m, shorter than a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet stub off a through road; Carmody Road traffic passes about 20 m away.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on the stub; a Carmody Road sign sets 2P limits with resident permits excepted, weekdays 7am-6pm.

flags: Resident-permit 2P sign on Carmody Road, weekdays 7am-6pm
Stub may be narrow with trees close to the lane
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the section from both sides; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: Exact sealed width of the stub
